faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How quickly will I receive an offer?
faq.a1: Usually within 24 hours after we receive your request.
faq.a2: We buy all makes and models - even vehicles with issues or without inspection.
faq.a3: By immediate bank transfer upon vehicle handover.
faq.a4: Yes, there are no costs for you. We pick up the vehicle for free.
faq.a5: We review your information and contact you by phone or email with an offer.
